name: study 175, the perturbation side study: the 35 laws of study 174 that the score settles, each run again and perturbed at random at four radii, 4 laws a radius
question: The operator's (2026-11-23 11:21): is each of the best laws a region of laws that behave alike, or a point where changing a coefficient by 0.001 changes everything; and what in a law's terms leads to what dimensional behaviour. The operator's question (2026-10-13): can simple local rules make a graph grow a real dimension, like space; which keep one they are given; and can the null map predict a law before it runs? Study 169 is the first study on the final probes, the installed table and the deterministic fleet (800 to 806), run on 813, its data the first clean data (the operator, 2026-11-19 21:11: "This way, we immediately have clean data from our latest codebase").

decided.why_now: the operator, 2026-11-23 11:21: "a specific side study to randomly perturb all the best candidates and see whether or not theres a region or if its all one-off flukes where changing even 0.001 changes the entire thing", after 846 mended the score
decided.holders: the 35 laws of `study_175_holders.json`: every drawn law of 174's first bundle (2026-11-23 09:52Z) that 846's score, read on the bundle, settles, its scoring start not frozen; each law rebuilt from its ledger row and checked by its fingerprint. The standing controls are left out: their chain starts at their answer
decided.radii: each of a law's real parameters (every term's coefficient, a power's exponent, beta at finite temperature, the locality and the swap share where drawn) moves by between half its radius and its radius, up or down, all together, from a stream of its own (`research/perturb.py`); a zero-temperature law keeps its beta, which its dynamics never read. 1e-9 moves nothing a chain can feel and gives the law new random numbers: it is the matched control, the spread of the law itself. 0.001 is the operator's question; 0.01 and 0.1 measure how wide a region is
decided.space: a variant must be a law of the declared space (the language's checks and the proposer's: a sparse phase, bounded below, within the coefficient bound); a draw that leaves it is drawn again and the refusal kept beside the variant
decided.run_again: each holder runs again as it is, on the same seeds: the fleet is deterministic, so it reads what it read in 174, a check of the replay at no cost to the question
decided.gates: the fact gates act as in 174 (empty, too dense, disconnected, a tenth let through); starts_alike and nothing_read only record, so that no variant is stopped on a judgment its holder passed. The cut gate and starts_apart_by_history record as in 174
decided.cost: about 1.0 core-hour a law, from the holders' own cost in 174, said in the criterion
